infotexts.entitydescription.shotgun_db: A simple double-barrel shotgun, manufactured by Chinese colonies. The cheapest 12g gun out of all, isn't capable of shooting underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.shotgun_assalt: A short combat shotgun, capable of being slam-fired. Perfect weapon for breaching operations in closed quarters, but loses to almost any other shotgun in terms of accuracy.
infotexts.entitydescription.pipegun12: Simple weapon, made of pipes and broken tool parts. As all makeshift weapons, this one has a chance to jam upon firing and is not capable of shooting underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.shotgun_water_unique: Self-spoken legendary shotgun. Outstanding fire rate and accuracy as well as underwater-shooting ability makes it ideal for narrow hulls and caves, however only few of them were brought to Europa and the weapon was never mass-manufactured.
infotexts.entitydescription.shotgun_water: Trusty shotgun, used by hunters and breachers for over 225 years. This modification comes with folding stock and is capable of shooting underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.shotgun_water2: Lightweight shotgun, developed for narrow corridors and closed quarters. Widely used by Coalition's police and special-taskers, earned its name as an ideal weapon for devastating no-knock raids. Shoots underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.shotgun_water_unique2: Heavy automatic shotgun, based on AK-like rifle. Unlike most Saigas, this one doesn't feed from detachable magazines but uses its own tube under the barrel. Fabrication requires some parts of another shotgun - TOZ-208.
infotexts.entitydescription.shotgun_talent: Semi-automatic combat shotgun, capable of firing at an incredibly fast rate. Was a common part of special squad's equipment on earth, but only a few of them made their way to Europa.
infotexts.entitydescription.shotgun_toz: An unidentified double-barrel shotgun, illegally shipped to Europa by Russian colonists, never intended to be used underwater, but for some reason is capable of doing so. There's an inscription on the stock, saying: Djahnem?
infotexts.entitydescription.shotgun_air: Mossberg's most known weapon on Europa. Most commonly seen as an outpost police shotgun, this weapon can hardly be called a reliable tool for hunting since it was not made for underwater usage.
infotexts.entitydescription.939_ar_un: Precise semi-automatic 9x39 rifle with relatively low recoil. Developed as a reliable marksman weapon with a subsonic round for Coalition's special task forces.
infotexts.entitydescription.939_ar: Primarily used by special-task operators, this Russian prototype rifle may be considered the pinnacle of assault rifles for its stopping power, accuracy, and rate of fire. Uses standard 9x39 magazines.
infotexts.entitydescription.groza9: An unusual assault rifle that can be easily rechambered with a parts kit and a mill-fabricator. Performs perfectly both underwater and in the air. The underslung grenade launcher allows the user to shoot 40MM frag grenades.
infotexts.entitydescription.939_ar_tallent: A very uncommon weapon, chambered in 9x39. Few blueprints of the SR-14 were brought to Europa by Russian colonists; however, this rifle was never fabricated since then.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_pistol_un: A weapon devastating by its very nature, wielding the power of The Flame itself. A strong enough vessel to withstand The Flame. A shard of The Flame, contained in metal walls.
infotexts.entitydescription.smg9mm: Developed for Earth's police officers, this 9x19 submachinegun is widely used on Europa for its intended purposes, despite it never being made to work underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_carbine: Burst-fire 9x19 carbine, deadly at long ranges, but loses effectiveness up close due to slower fire rate.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_smg_blueprint: Rapid-firing, precise 9x19 submachinegun, developed for underwater usage. Soon after launch, it was banned by the coalition as an inhumane weapon. The only drawbacks are its size and weight.
infotexts.entitydescription.9_smg_un: Fast-firing, silent SMG, widely used by mercenaries all over Europa, chambered in standard 9x19. Small size and ability for underwater shooting make it one of the best options for operations at medium and short ranges.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_smg_alt: Fast-firing compact submachinegun, compensating for its lack of accuracy with fire rate. Burns through ammo quickly but has rather good stopping power, uses standard SMG 9x19 magazines.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_smg_water: Simple 9x19 submachinegun, constructed for underwater usage. Despite relatively low fire rate, the advantage of underwater shooting makes M87 a demanded weapon.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_pistol_water2: Light burst-fire pistol chambered in 9x19, capable of quickly dealing out a lot of damage at close range. Has high recoil and relatively low accuracy.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_pistol_water: Light 9x19 pistol, made for special forces and shipped to Europa by their former operators. Became popular for its ability to work underwater and accuracy.
infotexts.entitydescription.9pipegun: Improvised open-bolt submachinegun, made of rusty pipes and scrap. Like all makeshift weapons, this one has a chance to jam upon firing and is not capable of shooting underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_pistol: Most common weapon on Europa. Cheap and effective, this 9x19 pistol became an essential part of every single submarine crew's arsenal. Can't shoot underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.762_rifle_obrez: A tradition of making Obrez versions of rifles has passed through hundreds of years and even made its way to Europa. This shortened rifle has its barrel and stock cut down, allowing it to be carried as a sidearm.
infotexts.entitydescription.rifle_co: An old-fashioned Japanese rifle with a grenade discharger, chambered in 40MM grenades. Effective at long ranges.
infotexts.entitydescription.762pipegun: Simple weapon, made of pipes and broken tool parts. Like all makeshift weapons, this one has a chance to jam upon firing and is not capable of shooting underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.762_rifle_unique: Heavy semi-automatic rifle, chambered in 7.62x55, manufactured by Dragunov's concern. A dozen of them were shipped to Europa where they were used as long-ranged sniper rifles. Uses its own 7.62x55 magazines.
infotexts.entitydescription.revolver_762: Bulky 7.62x55 revolver, designed for underwater hunting. Drum holds up to 3 rounds. Earned its name as one of the heftiest handguns on Europa.
infotexts.entitydescription.762_rifle: Bolt-action 7.62x55 rifle. Commonly used as a hunting weapon, but the penetration power of the round makes it ideal for fighting against armored opponents.
infotexts.entitydescription.762_rifle_s: Silent and precise 7.62x55 rifle, developed for Russian saboteur squads back on Earth. Few blueprints of Vimpels were brought to Europa; however, the rifle was never used since then. Ideal weapon for silently taking down any target.
infotexts.entitydescription.762_rifle_sonar: Semi-automatic rifle, chambered in 7.62x55 with an integrated magazine. The most unique feature of this weapon is, obviously, a sonar scope, hard-mounted on top, allowing the user to engage targets with no need to see them directly.
infotexts.entitydescription.762_rifle_2: Heavy 7.62x55 rifle, developed as a replacement for SVD-55ME. Bullpup layout makes this gun relatively more agile and easier to handle in closed spaces but also increases the recoil effect and decreases stability. Uses 7.62x55 magazines.
infotexts.entitydescription.machinegun: A heavy machinegun, brought to Europa by Italian colonists. Its size made it impossible to replicate with standard fabricators, meaning that MG3ME exists in a single copy. Cannot be modified.
infotexts.entitydescription.machinegun_air: A light 7.62 Kurz machinegun, used by police and special-task groups while operating inside outposts and submarines. Simple construction and reliability made M21 a popular choice for close combat. Unfortunately, this machinegun is not capable of firing underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.machinegun_alt: A boxy 7.62 Kurz machinegun, designed by Coalition as a powerful suppression and fire support weapon for its assault groups. This must be the heaviest weapon you've operated so far.
infotexts.entitydescription.machinegun_unique: A compact light machinegun, designed as part of a joint weaponry program between Russia and NATO. Chambered in 7.62 Kurz, this gun provides massive firepower in closed quarters, does not fear water and pressure of Europa's depths, and serves reliably to anyone capable of wielding its recoil.
infotexts.entitydescription.556_lever: Single-action 5.56x45 rifle with a lever to pull the breech block backwards, allowing the user to load the round directly into the barrel. These rifles became so widespread that even their blueprints were integrated into military fabricator standard recipe pool.
infotexts.entitydescription.556_carbine: AR-like carbine with a fast-firing rate and decent accuracy. Uses standard 5.56x45 magazines. Unable to shoot underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.556_ar_com: A modified version of M4-29. Comes with an underslung grenade launcher, improved muzzle break, and tactical light. Essential inner parts are replaced with identical ones made out of alien materials.
infotexts.entitydescription.556_smg: Simple yet effective 5.56x45 assault rifle. Was a standard piece of NATO soldiers' arsenal back on Earth. Nowadays on Europa, it serves as a heavy police weapon against rioters and terrorists. Jams underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.556_ar: Common military rifle, known for its reliability and accuracy. A good choice for a wealthy marksman, chambered in 5.56x45.
infotexts.entitydescription.556_ar_b: Experimental 5.56x45 assault rifle. High accuracy and ability for underwater shooting make it perfect for middle-ranged combat under any circumstances Europa has to offer.
infotexts.entitydescription.556_dmr: Semi-automatic 5.56x45 rifle. Known for its incredible accuracy and large size. Used as a long-range weapon outside of outposts and submarines by coalition's special task forces.
infotexts.entitydescription.556_ar_spec: Deadly and precise 5.56x45 assault rifle, famous among mercenaries for its reliability and accuracy. Combined with a flashlight from the factory, this rifle provides its operator with great firepower in air and water.
infotexts.entitydescription.556_ar_burst: Rapid-firing carbine, capable of firing 5.56x45 ammo in quick bursts of 3. A reliable weapon for close-quarters combat.
infotexts.entitydescription.carbine_medic: Precise 5.56x45 carbine, developed for combat medics. Has an integrated health scanner and underslung syringe launcher. Perfect for keeping your squad alive while still having an option to fight back against any threat, no matter the conditions. Cannot be suppressed or modified in any way.
infotexts.entitydescription.545_carbine: Self-loading Volkov's Carbine, or SKV, is a precise 5.45x39 rifle with its own fixed magazine, holding 8 bullets. Not the fastest firing gun, but highly accurate. Its muzzle brake cannot accommodate a Rifle Grenade Launcher.
infotexts.entitydescription.545_ar: Shortened version of AK-27 with folding stock. Originally for tank crews, repurposed as a police weapon on Europa. Incapable of shooting underwater. Uses 5.45x39 magazines.
infotexts.entitydescription.545_ar_uw: Modern assault rifle, designed to rival the M4-29. High rate of fire and accuracy, coupled with a folding stock, makes it one of Europa's top 5.45 weapons.
infotexts.entitydescription.545_ar_uw_un: Modified AEK-22 with collimator sight, polymer stock, tactical flashlight, and bayonet. Some parts replaced with alien materials, making it lighter and more durable. Feeds from 5.45x39 magazines.
infotexts.entitydescription.545_aru: Semi-automatic rifle, known for its accuracy and deadly long-range capabilities among AK patterns. Uses standard 5.45x39 magazines.
infotexts.entitydescription.groza45: Unusual assault rifle, convertible with a parts kit and a fabricator. Performs well underwater and in air. Features an underslung grenade launcher for 40MM frag grenades.
infotexts.entitydescription.545_pipe_ar: Assault rifle made of scrap, pipes, and tool parts. May jam upon firing and cannot shoot underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.545_ar_burst: A new generation AK-32's was constructed for Europa's harsh conditions. Designed for silent, precise shots in bursts of 2 bullets. Uses standard 5.45x39 magazines.
infotexts.entitydescription.545_ar_alt: Precise rifle offering an in-between variant among 5.45x39 weapons. Reliable and trustworthy, balancing firing speed and accuracy.
infotexts.entitydescription.545_ar_bandit: Rapid-firing 5.45x39 assault rifle for close quarters combat. Loses effectiveness with range due to high recoil and poor accuracy.
infotexts.entitydescription.57_pistol: Light pistol chambered in standard 5.7x28. Known for its incredible penetration power and ability to shoot underwater, making it reliable for self-defense.
infotexts.entitydescription.57_pistol_tallent: Experimental automatic pistol chambered in standard 5.7. All essential parts made entirely of alien materials.
infotexts.entitydescription.57_smg: Rapid-firing micro-SMG chambered in 5.7x28. Deadly at point-blank range but suffers from low accuracy and lethality of rounds. Jams underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.57_pistol_tact: Advanced 5.7x28 pistol designed for scouting squads on Earth. Renowned for its reliability and convenience in shooting, brought to Europa by former operators.
infotexts.entitydescription.45_smg_micro: Compact .45 submachine gun developed for special task forces. Lightweight for its caliber, easily wielded with one hand, but suffers from high recoil and low accuracy.
infotexts.entitydescription.45_pistol_uw: Modern .45 pistol used by special task forces on Europa. Compact, reliable, and deadly, posing a threat both in water and on land. Fabrication ceased after the collapse of SC Special-Task, now found sparingly.
infotexts.entitydescription.45_pistol_uw2: Modern .45 pistol designed for military use. Reliable with high rate of fire and powerful round.
infotexts.entitydescription.45pipegun: Improvised open-bolt submachine gun made of rusty pipes and scrap. Prone to jamming, incapable of shooting underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.45_carbine: .45 carbine designed for underwater use, fed by standard .45 pistol magazines. Realizes less than 90% of round's potential damage due to its semi-improvised nature.
infotexts.entitydescription.45_smg_uw2: Burst-fire .45 submachine gun developed for coalition assault squads. High rate of fire, quick ammo depletion, and relatively high accuracy due to unique receiver system.
infotexts.entitydescription.45_smg_uw: .45 submachine gun designed for underwater use. Offers accuracy and low recoil to compensate for its relatively low rate of fire.
infotexts.entitydescription.45_pistol: Common .45 pistol known for its firepower and accuracy, but prone to jamming underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.45_smg: Heavy .45 submachine gun based on HK-90 assault rifle. Reliable in close-quarter fights but not capable of shooting underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.revolver_44_com: Modified version of the standard RKX-5 revolver, featuring a suppressor, red dot sight, and laser pointer. Inner parts replaced with analogs made from alien materials.
infotexts.entitydescription.revolver_44: Revolver designed for space export, the 5th model in the series. While not the most famous Russian weapon, it's renowned for its reliability and firepower, chambered in .44.
infotexts.entitydescription.44pipegun: Improvised revolver made from pipes. Like all makeshift weapons, it carries a risk of jamming and is unsuitable for underwater use.
infotexts.entitydescription.revolver_44_auto: Powerful revolver chambered in standard .44 caliber, with a relatively faster firing speed, making it deadly in close combat. However, it sacrifices accuracy for speed.
infotexts.entitydescription.44_rifle_lever: Simple yet effective lever-action .44 rifle originally designed for underwater hunting, also suitable as a rapid-firing combat rifle with excellent accuracy and relatively inexpensive ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.revolver_38_talent: A simple-to-construct .38 revolver featuring a drum for 4 rounds. Its poor weight balance and makeshift nature make it feel rather unwieldy compared to factory-produced alternatives.
infotexts.entitydescription.revolver_38: An affordable and widely-used weapon for self-defense chambered in .38, although it cannot shoot underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.38_carbine: Originally an experiment, this weapon became widespread among miners due to its small size and accuracy. It's ideal for defending against unarmored species of Europa in caves and ocean depths. Utilizes special .38 magazines.
infotexts.entitydescription.silencer_38: A simple pistol with an integrated suppressor, capable of firing one .38 round with incredible accuracy. Developed long ago for Chinese special forces on Earth, it performs well under various conditions. It's become popular among criminals due to its affordability and obscurity.
infotexts.entitydescription.revolver_38_uw: A fast-firing .38 revolver capable of underwater shooting, with a capacity of 7 rounds.
infotexts.entitydescription.38_carbine_2: A unique twin-barrel .38 rifle with an integrated magazine holding up to 10 rounds. Both barrels fire simultaneously, delivering a precise and deadly burst of two bullets.
infotexts.entitydescription.44_round: Powerful round with piercing cap. Good against all kinds of threats.
infotexts.entitydescription.44_round_explosive: .44 Round, modified with explosive heading. Acts like a little schrapnel grenade, dealing massive damage in a large radius.
infotexts.entitydescription.44_round_df: .44 round, modified with piercing depleted fuel cap. Penetrates up to 2 targets.
infotexts.entitydescription.44_round_homing: A round with a very lowpowder charge, instead of which, it has a little torpedo engine and fins. When used underwater, acts like a little heat seeking rocket, aiming at the closest non-human enemy.
infotexts.entitydescription.44_round_hs: These .44 rounds hae been modified with heavier bullets, relying on its weight when it comes to dealing damage. Leaves no tracer and performs better against soft targets, but has significantly less armor penetration.
infotexts.entitydescription.9x39_magazine: Standard magazine for best of assault rifles on Europa.
infotexts.entitydescription.9x39mm_round: A large round, relying on its weight rather than on speed to inflict damage. Fitted with an armor-piercing cap, this bullet is a truly unstoppable force.
infotexts.entitydescription.9x39mm_round_hs: A heavy subsonic round, designed to do horrendous damage to unarmored targets. Leaves to tracer.
infotexts.entitydescription.9x39mm_round_homing: A round with a very lowpowder charge, instead of which, it has a little torpedo engine and fins. When used underwater, acts like a little heat seeking rocket, aiming at the closest non-human enemy.
infotexts.entitydescription.9x39mm_round_df: A 9x39 round, acting similar to subcaliber sabots. Pierces through multiple surfaces.
infotexts.entitydescription.smg45_magazine: .A 11.5mm round magazin designed to fit in your standard SMG.
infotexts.entitydescription.45_round_rifle: A 11.5mm round magazine.\n (Contains rounds that have an increased power, so much so that it can be considered a rifle round. Gains additional damage from rifleman talent.)
infotexts.entitydescription.45_round_ap: A 11.5mm round with a piercing cap.
infotexts.entitydescription.45_round: A standard 11.5mm round. Common self-defence caliber with one of the highest stopping powers among civilian ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.45_round_rifle: With that much power it can be considered a rifle round. Gains additional damage from rifleman talent as if it was a sniper rifle round.
infotexts.entitydescription.pistol45_magazine: .A 11.5mm round magazin designed to fit in your standard pistol.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_round: Standard 9x19 round. Most common caliber for handguns and other pdws.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_round_ripper: A 9x19 round, modified to cause as much damage to exposed tissues as possible. Performs significantly worse against armor, doesnt get special bonuses from Modules.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_round_hs: Deals slightly more damage and leaves no tracer. Ideal for stealth operations.
infotexts.entitydescription.9mm_round_df: A 9x19 round, acting similar to subcaliber sabots. Pierces through multiple surfaces.
infotexts.entitydescription.5.45mm_round_incendiar: A 5.45 round with incendiary cap. Deals additional burn damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.5.45mm_round_hp: 5.45x39 round, modified to cause severe bleedings and deal more damage to unarmored targets. However, it lost a lot of its penetrating ability.
infotexts.entitydescription.5.45mm_round: A high-velocity round with titanium penetrator. Used in most weapons of ak pattern, effective against armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.5.45mm_round_sb: A rather weaker alternative to standard 5.45x39 ammunition. This round has lower stopping power and works significantly worse against armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.5.7mm_round: A round travelling at extremely high velocity, almost ignoring most standard armor vests and creature shells. However, it has a relativly low stopping power.
infotexts.entitydescription.5.7mm_round_lb: A cheap alternative to standard 5.7x28 round. Performs significantly worse in terms of both damage and penetration.
infotexts.entitydescription.5.7mm_round_hp: A 5.7x28 round, modified to perform somewhat better in terms of stopping power in exchange for piercing power. I guess you just refuse to use other pistol calibers...
infotexts.entitydescription.5.7mm_round_piercing: A 5.7x28 round, pushed to its extremes. Fire at incredivly high velocities, acting like a sub-caliber sabot.
infotexts.entitydescription.5.56mm_round: A deadly military round with piercing titanium core. Effective both against armor and whats beneath.
infotexts.entitydescription.5.56mm_round_hp: A 5.56 round, modified with a hollow-point head. Effective against exposed weakpoints and unarmored limbs.
infotexts.entitydescription.5.56mm_round_homing: A round with a very lowpowder charge, instead of which, it has a little torpedo engine and fins. When used underwater, acts like a little heat seeking rocket, aiming at the closest non-human enemy.
infotexts.entitydescription.7.62_magazine: Magazine, designed specially for SVD rifle series.
infotexts.entitydescription.7.62mm_round_incendiar: Powerful round with incendiary cap. Deals heavier damage, but had evnetually lost some armor piercing abilities.
infotexts.entitydescription.7.62mm_round_light: A 7.62x55 round, but instead of physicorium core, this one carries a solid titanium jacket. Slightly weaker against armor and deals a bit less damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.7.62mm_round: Powerfull round, carrying physicorium piercing core in a lead jacket. Perfect choice against heavily armored targets.
infotexts.entitydescription.7.62mm_round_df: Powerful round with great penetration abilities. Ideal for hunting on small and even medium Europa species.
infotexts.entitydescription.38_round: Standard .38 round with low piercing ability and medium stopping power. Good for self defence.
infotexts.entitydescription.38_round_df: .38 round with a depleted fuel heading. Effective against armor, tends to pierce multiple lairs of it.
infotexts.entitydescription.38_round_ap: Armor-piercing .38 round. The cap of this round is reinforced, a piercing core is added, making it suitable against armored targets.
infotexts.entitydescription.38_round_explosive: .38 modified with explosive warhead. Acts like a miniature frag greande.
infotexts.entitydescription.mg_magazine: An 80 round belt, designed for light machineguns, like A102 and M21.
infotexts.entitydescription.mg_round_ripper: A 7.62 Kurz round, modified to cause horrendous damage to tissues and internal organs. Performs significantly worse against all kinds of armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.mg_round_ap: A piercing 7.62x32 round with round head. Performs significantly better against armored enemies.
infotexts.entitydescription.mg_round_hp: A modified 7.62x32 round with hollow-point head. Good against unarmored targets, causes severe bleedings.
infotexts.entitydescription.mg_round: A standard 7.62x32 round with round head. Used in most machineguns on Europa. Effective at close ranges against or unarmored or weakly-armored targets.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_flarerounds: Emitting bright light upon firing, these rounds are crucial for signaling and navigating underwater.
infotexts.entitydescription.sturmfaustrocket: Standard ammunition for the SFZ-12 Rocket Launcher. Explodes on impact, dealing massive damage to hulls and creatures alike.
infotexts.entitydescription.L39Mag: A top-mounted magazine for the Lahti L-39, holding 10 rounds of 20×138B ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.20mm_ammo: A massive round, relying on its weight and speed to inflict a massive amount of damage. Fitted with an armor-piercing cap, this bullet is truly an unstoppable force.
infotexts.entitydescription.nucleargun_magazine: A magazine-battery complex developed for the AGR-21 Rifle. Nuclear batteries tend to act unstable upon discharge, causing minor radiation emissions, so it is recommended to use the AGR-21 while wearing radiation-protective clothing. Holds 10 8x45mm needles.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_shotgunslug: A solid 12g projectile useful at medium to long ranges, with incredible piercing power.
infotexts.entitydescription.shotgundart: A shotgun round carrying deadly darts, capable of piercing armor and tearing through targets. Effective against any target, with the only drawback being the number of pellets - 6 instead of the usual 16 for normal buckshot.
infotexts.entitydescription.sword_murza: This blade seems to vibrate in your hands, vibrating at such a high frequency that it can effortlessly slice through anything.
infotexts.entitydescription.M2A1: An antique weapon that has found its way onto Europa. While being outdated and slightly dangerous, it has found its uses. These uses mainly involve a great way to remove ballast flora from docked ships.
infotexts.entitydescription.madmanshorn: How far is comedy from a tragedy? No further than a few millimeters.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_flaregun: The Wolseley Signal Pistol, Model 1917 is a compact and reliable signaling tool, essential for communication in challenging environments during the Great War era.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_lab_backpack: This strange item was found on an asteroid that struck Europa sometime ago.
infotexts.entitydescription.easterwrench: A wrench that only the most valiant and strong engineers of Europa may wield.
infotexts.entitydescription.clownsuitunique_ruined: While these garbs are outdated and worn, they still show the true might of the Honk Father.
infotexts.entitydescription.ballistichelmet_scst: A solid steel protective helmet designed for breaching operations and close quarters combat. The purpose of the two horns on the frontal part remains unknown.
infotexts.entitydescription.combatdivingsuit_god: A surprisingly warm diving suit, though it gives you a weird feeling of unease while wearing it. It also has a strange sulphuric smell inside.
infotexts.entitydescription.guidebook: A handwritten guidebook that can help you understand the basics of underwater combat and hopefully will increase your lifespan in the hostile waters of Europa.
infotexts.entitydescription.tomebook: A poorly drawn sketch of something unknown.
infotexts.entitydescription.depthchargelauncher: A homemade weapon crafted from what looks like a steam cannon and a depth charge tube. It seems like this is a last-resort weapon judging by how it was found.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_alienheadset: This strange helmet allows you to read the strange alien text found across Europa.
infotexts.entitydescription.modded_smgmagazinedepl: Old-gen 9x19 SMG magazine with a depleted fuel payload. Effective against armor, tends to pierce multiple layers of it.
infotexts.entitydescription.modded_riflebullet: Standard .30 caliber round. Used by standard infantry.
infotexts.entityname.modded_smgrounddepletedfuel: 9x19 round with a depleted fuel payload.
infotexts.entitydescription.suppressor: A simple, yet effective suppression device for firearms. After installation, it lowers the noticeability of a gunshot for hostile creatures.
infotexts.entitydescription.blueprint_ammo: A blueprint for military fabricators. Contains ammunition recipes.
infotexts.entitydescription.blueprint_weapon: A blueprint for standard and military fabricators. Contains weapon recipes.
infotexts.entitydescription.round_noff: Smart rounds do not collide with teammates, reducing friendly fire possibility to zero.
infotexts.entitydescription.compatibility_weapon: If you see this weapon, it means that it's here for compatibility. Deconstruct this weapon to get the "Combat Overhaul Reloaded" version.
infotexts.entitydescription.Hidden: This is meant to be hidden and not meant to show up in the game.
infotexts.entitydescription.corporalcoin: Flip the coin to get a random talent.
infotexts.entitydescription.blueprint_cps: A blueprint for military fabricators. Contains attachment recipe.
infotexts.entitydescription.flakcannonammoboxstun: A box of heavy rounds, each carrying a fulgurium warhead, creating stunning fields upon detonation.
infotexts.entitydescription.flakcannonammoboxchemi: A box of heavy rounds with sulphuritin payload, creating a screen of deadly gas upon detonation.
infotexts.entitydescription.flakcannonammoboxsolid: A box of heavy blunt rounds that do not carry any explosives. Contains 33 shells instead of 25.
infotexts.entitydescription.chaingunammoboxstabili: These rounds come with stabilisation fins, greatly enhancing their accuracy and effective range as a result.
infotexts.entitydescription.dmindammobox: A belt of coilgun rounds with warheads of solid neurotoxin, applying Dementonite Poisoning.
infotexts.entitydescription.chemicalammobox: Rounds emmit a cloud of deadly corrosive gas upon detonation, burning through armor and flesh of any target.
infotexts.entitydescription.piercinglaserbox: Improved lence in conjunction with a more reactive mixture form a focused ray, capable of piercing hulls and thick shells while retaining good striking power.
infotexts.entitydescription.chaingunammobox_deplet: A box of 20MM sub-caliber rounds with depleted uranium core. Probably the most effective chaingun ammo in terms of armor piercing.
infotexts.entitydescription.incendiaryammobox: A box of heavy coilgun rounds, inflicting severe burns upon detonation. Can cause fires if used inside hulls.
infotexts.entitydescription.sulprailgunshell: Upon detonation this railgun shell emmits a cloud of toxic corrosive gas, burning anyone withing its radius. Chemical mixture reacts violently in contact with hulls and ice.
infotexts.entitydescription.scatterammobox_coilgun: After exiting the barrel rounds split into three separate bolts, dealing massive damage to unarmored targets.
infotexts.entitydescription.pulselaserminingammobo: This mixture creates a cascade of beams that result in a massive seismic resonance upon hit. This resonance detaches minerals from ice and deals great damage to hulls and armour alike. It proved to be ineffective against the local wildlife, however.
infotexts.entitydescription.unstablelaserbox: The component's reaction in this fuel mixture is unpredictable. It will usually create an impulse slightly weaker than a normal laser, but with a chance of around 20% for a powerful energy blast, forming a ray with 20% more damage. R&D also claims there's a rare chance that this reaction can lead to a massive energy discharge, overdriving laser systems and dealing triple damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.chaingunammoboxdemento: A box of 20MM chaingun rounds with caps of solid neurotoxin, disorienting any enemy on hit. However, they have diminished armour piercing capabilities compared to standard rounds.
infotexts.entitydescription.railgun_cartridge_shel: This railgun shell uses a cartridge filled with explosives to boost its velocity. Incredible speed and armour piercing but cartridges must be refilled after every shot.
infotexts.entitydescription.apherailgunshell: This shell carries a heavy explosive charge covered with an AP cap. It explodes after piercing the armour, dealing massive internal damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.railgunshell_chitin: A chitin cap that splinters after piercing an enemy, creating a huge amount of fragments.
infotexts.entitydescription.emprailgunshell: Creates a massive EMP burst upon detonation. Stuns large enemies and damages electronics of enemy submarine.
infotexts.entitydescription.pulselaserdischargeamm: This unique fuel box comes with a shockwave transductor instead of lenses. Upon firing it creates a massive shock impulse, stunning and damaging enemies in the area around the turret.
infotexts.entitydescription.pulselaserweldingammob: This fuel box turns the pulse laser into a powerful welding tool. The damage values are a bit lower compared to the regular pulse laser.
infotexts.entitydescription.jetammobox: Each shell is armed with a ballistic warhead and a torpedo jet engine. Effective against fast moving or heavily armoured targets.
infotexts.entitydescription.fulguriumammobox: These shells carry a Fulgurium warhead which shocks every enemy on impact.
infotexts.entityname.coilgunammoboxpiercing_capped: Coilgun armour piercing ballistic capped ammo box
infotexts.entitydescription.coilgunammoboxpiercing: Piercing ammo with a ballistic cap that splinters inside enemies, causing higher internal damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.coilgunammoboxflak: This box contains high-calibre explosive coilgun rounds with a simple sonar detonator on each. After being fired, they will explode not only on contact but also in proximity to anything they pass.
infotexts.entitydescription.chaingunammoboxexplosi: Box of chaingun ammunition with a plastic explosive warhead. Effective at both tearing fleshy targets apart and blasting through submarine's hull.
infotexts.entitydescription.chaingunammoboxscatter: Shells splinter after being fired. Effective against swarms of enemies or large unarmoured creatures.
infotexts.self_causeofdeathdescription.dmind: You have died from dementonite poisoning.
infotexts.entitydescription.laser_t: A red laser pointer that can be attached to a firearm instead of the tactical flashlight. While active, negates the slowdown effect while aiming.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_riflecoil: Can be attached to firearms chambered in .38, .44, and 7.62x55. Accelerates the bullet as it travels through the barrel, improving damage by 30% but requires some time to charge up before firing.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_bolt: Can be attached to bolt/lever/pump-action firearms. Increases their fire rate.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_trigger: Can be installed on non-automatic revolvers to greatly increase fire rate.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_boostercoil: An attachment for 40MM grenade launchers. Improves muzzle velocity and direct damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_choke: An attachment for 12g shotguns. Improves buckshot pellet alignment and decreases their spread. Does not work for solid projectiles.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_shootunderwater: A complex barrel attachment that neutralizes pressure drop between a weapon's chamber and the external environment. Allows underwater firing for guns that weren't capable of it before but lowers fire rate slightly. To properly use CPS, you need to first unjam your gun in a dry environment with atmospheric pressure and only then attach the system; otherwise, it won't have any effect on your firearm.
infotexts.entitydescription.medscanner_t: A medical scanner that can be attached to a weapon, like a tactical flashlight.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_riflegrenade: A 40MM launching device that may be attached to the barrel of 5.45x39, 5.56x45, and 9x39 assault rifles. Has a simple trigger linkage system, shooting before the gun itself starts firing.
infotexts.entitydescription.thermalsight: Grants thermal goggles effect if the weapon is active. Can be attached to 7.62x55 rifles.
infotexts.entitydescription.flashlight_t: A flashlight with a reinforced body and a rail, allowing it to be attached to weapons.
infotexts.entitydescription.resistattachment: A module that can be attached to the beginning of a weapon's barrel. Decreases incoming physical damage by 20% while you are aiming. Can be attached to 7.62x55 firearms.
infotexts.entitydescription.accuraccyattachment: A module that can be attached to the beginning of a weapon's barrel. Decreases initial spread and recoil while you are standing still. Can be attached to 7.62 Kurz and .45 firearms.
infotexts.entitydescription.critattachment: A module that can be attached to the beginning of a weapon's barrel. Bullets have a chance to deal extra damage with this module. Can be attached to 9x19, 7.62 Kurz, .38, and 5.7x28 firearms. Works with any ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.sulpationattachment: A module that can be attached to the beginning of a weapon's barrel. Bullets create small clouds of damaging corrosive gas upon impacting surface or creature. Can be attached to 5.45, 5.56, and 9x39 assault rifles. Does not work with homing and depleted fuel ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.fireattachment: A module that can be attached to the beginning of a weapon's barrel. Can be attached to shotguns, works only with standard and lethal buckshot. Pellets ignite the target, causing it to suffer from a damage-over-time effect for up to 15 seconds.
infotexts.entitydescription.shockattachment: A module that can be attached to the beginning of a weapon's barrel. Adds a much longer stun and EMP effect to your shots, can be attached to 9x19, .45, 7.62 Kurz, and 5.7x28 firearms. Special ammunition, like Explosive, Depleted Fuel, and Ripper rounds, don't get bonuses from this module.
infotexts.entitydescription.radiationattachment: A module that can be attached to the beginning of a weapon's barrel. Bullets under its effect create small slowing and radiating explosions on impact. Can be attached to any weapon, only works with standard, Incendiary, Hollow-point, Smart, Subsonic, Increased powder charge, Armor-piercing, and Lightweight ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.gunpowder: A volatile explosive mixture, commonly used to fabricate ammunition.
A stable explosive mixture, commonly used in old fassion weapons.\nWhen in contact with water, it will rapidly decay into a unuseable slug.
infotexts.entitydescription.skillbookscst: And then he cried: Europe, not Europa! And then they proceed to fulfill their mission.. Alone..
infotexts.M12: M12: "When are we doing the bucket war again?"\n\n Message failed to send
infotexts.govno: Battle Engineer: "What the fuck did you add to your submarine?"\n\nM12: Why is there anime on this sub?
infotexts.EF: Battle Engineer: "Thank you Evil Factory, you have given the Barotrauma community so much. You keep making amazing mods for free, I know its not much but this is my thank you."
infotexts.missiondescription.honkfatherrescue: The bandit group occupying the abandoned [location1] has issued a peculiar demand. They're holding a mysterious figure known only as the 'Honk-Father' and are demanding a ransom for their release. The Coalition, firm in its stance against negotiation with such groups, and instead has offered a substantial reward to anyone brave enough to rescue the enigmatic captive.
infotexts.missionfailure.honkfatherrescue: The Honk-Father has been lost to the seas.
infotexts.missionmessage0.honkfatherrescue: The Honk-Father is now safely aboard the submarine. To complete the mission, undock from the outpost.
infotexts.missiondescription.escorthonkfather: A mysterious clown claiming to be the "Honk-Father" is requesting an esort and is willing to part with one on his outfits and some money.
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather1.low: A clown is meandering through the corridors, idly tracing their finger along the walls. Upon catching sight of you, they pause and inquire, "Are you familiar with the concept of the Honkmother?"
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather1.low.o1.c1: "You've glimpsed our Pillars of Fun. I trust you, fellow clown," they declare with a knowing nod.
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather1.low.o3: "She is the emptiness inside the balloon."
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather1.low.o2.c1: "Perhaps it's time to empty your chalice of stale wine instead."
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather1.c1: A clown is casually strolling through the corridors, trailing their fingers along the walls as they move. Upon noticing you, their eyes twinkle behind their mask. "Hey there, fellow clown, am I right?"
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather1.o1.c1: "I was waiting for a couple of other clowns, but they got nabbed for bonking someone with a toy hammer. We were supposed to hop to another station, but now we're marooned in a locale where we're about as welcome as a fart in a diving suit." It's hard to tell if the clown is maintaining eye contact with you, but you sense their gaze doesn't linger for more than a few seconds.
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather1.takeonboard: Extend an invitation to the solitary clown.
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather1.great: "Fantastic!" they exclaim with enthusiasm. "I'll go fetch my gear!" Their excitement is contagious, though you hope they won't cause too much chaos.
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather.refuse: "To be honest, clowns aren't really my cup of tea," you admit with a sheepish smile.
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather.ignore: "I hate to break it to you, but this getup isn't mine, I just snagged it." you confess sheepishly.
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather.ignore.c2: The clown lets out a long, disappointed sigh.
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather2.c1: While inspecting the submarine, the individual you conversed with at the station emerges from a cabin, their mask lifted slightly, unveiling a wide, unsettling grin. "Are you prepared to encounter our jester?" Before you can reply, a peculiar elderly figure clad in a tattered, eccentric clown ensemble emerges, crawling out of a crate.
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather2.o1: You instinctively take a step back in surprise.
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather2.o1.c1: "What on earth?!" you exclaim, startled. "Don't worry," the clown assures you, "he may seem odd, but he's quite harmless," he adds, tilting his head slightly.
infotexts.eventtext.honkfather2.music: The Honk Father continues to play music but remains silent.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_headset_protective: A lightly modified version of the standard headset with rails for attachments such as a light.
infotexts.entitydescription.militaryclothes_separa: Rugged costume used mainly by low-rank separatist officers and field commanders. Provides some protection against physical damage, but pales in comparison to more heavily armored clothes. Has tactical pockets for medicine and ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.militaryclothes_eng: Protective outfit, designed for on-field engineering teams. May not be the most comfortable clothing but has enough armor to stop a pistol-caliber bullet or prevent smaller creatures from biting through it.
infotexts.entitydescription.militaryclothes_medic: A set of rugged sturdy clothes, designed to protect medical personnel in combat situations. Unlike common medical uniforms carries additional pouches for ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.militaryclothes_medic_: A medical uniform tailored for a pragmatic medic, marked '5714' on the right shoulder. It includes a pistol holster and a knife sheath on the left shoulder, ensuring preparedness for any situation.
infotexts.entitydescription.ballistichelmet_bandit: Heavy bulletproof helmet, reinforced with steel plates. Effective against low-caliber firearms, bites and slashes.
infotexts.entitydescription.light_tachelm: A ballistic helmet with full tactical AAS sensor set and visor. Improves wearer's performance in ranged combat, like the AAS Interface itself does.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_riotarmor: A set of heavy plated armor for full torso protection. Mainly used by Coalition's riot control squads this vest provides incredible resistances from burns, explosions, lacerations and other threats that you may encounter while suppressing another insurgency.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_bodyarmor_improvise: An improvised armored vest, designed to protect only the most vital parts of wearer's torso. Composed of metal sheets and straps it provides decent protection for its cost.
infotexts.entitydescription.divingsuit_improviseda: A diving suit, reinforced with pieces of Makeshift Armor. Grants significantly better protection from physical damage, but lowers wearer's mobility severely.
infotexts.entitydescription.militaryclothes_clown: Let nothing stop you from delivering fun, destruction, destructive fun and funny destruction.
infotexts.entitydescription.clowndivingmaskunique: Nothing remains hidden under the mother's gaze.
infotexts.entitydescription.militaryclothes_weak: A set of durable clothes designed for underwater combat operations. Provides some decent protection as well as some spare pockets for ammunition and medicine.
infotexts.entitydescription.ballistichelmet_bandit: Light helmet, designed to protect submariners from fragments and shrapnel. Offers very low protection against firearms.
Heavy bulletproof helmet, reinforced with steel plates. Effective against low-caliber firearms, bites and slashes.
Heavy bulletproof helmet, reinforced with steel plates. Effective against low-caliber firearms, bites and slashes.
infotexts.entitydescription.tachelm_alt: A sturdy helmet with a facemask, made of solid plastic and ballistic fiber. Grants good protection against bites and schrapnel, may even stop a bullet or two.
infotexts.entitydescription.maidoutfit: First you gun down, then you clean up.
infotexts.entitydescription.militaryclothes: A sturdy overcoat, reinforced with kevlar and light metal plates, accompanied with tactical pockets for smaller items. Offers good protection against gunshots.
infotexts.entitydescription.militaryclothes2: Heavy, rugged overcoat, designed to protect against bite wounds and laceration injuries. Reinforced with light titanium plates and kevlar windings.
infotexts.entitydescription.banditclothes3: A homemade protective suit, reinforced with bent sheets of metal and layers of sturdy fibers.
infotexts.entitydescription.ballistichelmet_bandit: Light helmet, designed to protect submariners from fragments and shrapnel. Offers very low protection against firearms.
infotexts.entitydescription.tacticalhelmet: Heavy bulletproof helmet, designed for special-task operators. Physicorium plates provide great protection against firearms, bites, and explosives.
infotexts.entitydescription.bodyarmor_m: A heavier variant of bulletproof vest, designed for military purposes. Has some tactical pockets and a layered chestplate.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_nvg: Simple, improvised night vision device. Don't expect anything special, but it will somewhat improve your vision in darkness.
infotexts.entitydescription.exoskeleton_unarmored: A lightweight battery-powered exoskeleton frame designed for civilian usage. Greatly enhances operators physical strength and flow resistance.
infotexts.entitydescription.exoskeleton: Heavy rugged suit that utilises dublicate exoskeleton to allow the operator to move around in such armor. Uses batteries to power the frame. Offers incredible protection against firearms, bites, shrapnel, blunt force and explosions. Massivly increases operator's physical strength, but makes it relativly difficult to properly operate firearms.
infotexts.entitydescription.exoskeleton2: Heavy rugged suit that utilises dublicate exoskeleton to allow the operator to move around in such armor. Uses batteries to power the frame. Offers incredible protection against firearms, bites, shrapnel, blunt force and explosions. Massivly increases operator's physical strength, but makes it relativly difficult to properly operate firearms. This version grants full-body pressure protection.
infotexts.entitydescription.exoskeleton3: A deep modification of standard DES-12 exoskeleton, adapted to operating firearms, while retaining high combat mobility. Though overall protection against physical damage has lowered, this suit provides massive advantages, when it comes to firefights both in water and on land. Has a slot to put any weapon inside.
infotexts.entitydescription.exoskeleton4: A lighter version of diving exoskeletons, this one focuses more on exploration and scouting operations, providing wearer with greater mobility. Has an onboard sonar and scanning complex.
infotexts.talentname.kurz_craft: You can now craft: 7.62 Kurz ammunition!
infotexts.talentname.12_craft: You can now craft: shotgun ammunition!
infotexts.talentname.pdw_craft: You can now craft: PDW-323E submachinegun!
infotexts.talentname.pdw9_craft: You can now craft: CZE-900 Mauler submachinegun!
infotexts.talentname.rifle_craft: You can now craft: DVL-16 Vimpel rifle!
infotexts.talentname.shotgun_craft: You can now craft: Saiga A18
infotexts.talentname.pistol_craft: You can now craft: M19 Army pistol
infotexts.talentname.exo_craft: You can now craft: DES-8 Military Exoskeleton!
infotexts.talentname.mg_craft: You can now craft: M54 LMG!
infotexts.talentname.laser_craft: You can now craft: LCM-301 Cricket Laser Rifle!
infotexts.talentname.ak_craft: You can now craft: AK-32MSU Perun rifle!
infotexts.talentname.ar556_craft: You can now craft: G-14K Assault Carbine!
infotexts.talentname.melee_craft: You can now craft: Advanced melee weapons!
infotexts.talentname.cps_craft: You can now craft: Chamber pressure stabiliser!
infotexts.talentname.omni_craft: The radio operator was eaten by a worm.
infotexts.talentname.scst_craft: His wrath has since corrupted him.
infotexts.talentdescription.scst_craft: Twisted his mind, and warped his weapon.
infotexts.talentdescription.craftvariant: You can craft [itemname] with much cheaper materials.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_fraggrenade: Improved version of the standard frag grenade with a shortened fuze delay. The payload stays the same, but a new polymer stick is added, increasing throw force and giving the grenade neutral buoyancy.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_aps: A compact APS set, designed to provide full 360-degree protection to its wearer. Has a high-frequency infrared laser to shoot down incoming threats and a passive radar complex to identify them. Can intercept harpoons, coilgun bolts, spineling spikes, 40MMs, and throwable grenades with ease, but struggles with bigger and faster-moving targets (like railgun shells, homing rounds, improved frag grenades, chaingun, or piercing coilgun bolts). For obvious reasons, it can't work at point-blank ranges, but doesn't restrict the wearer from using deflectable munitions.
infotexts.entitydescription.40mmgrenadeguided: A 40MM grenade with a heat-seeking head and a little torpedo engine. When shot underwater, homes onto the closest non-human enemy.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_remotedet: A remote detonator for Combat Explosive Charges. Has a range of 8000 units. Detonates all armed charges at once.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_c4charge: A multi-purpose military explosive charge, designed for sabotage operations. Can be attached to a wall or just put anywhere you want. If attached, can be wired as a standard detonator and will go off upon receiving any signal. If safety or timed mode are off (by default), can be triggered remotely by Remote Detonator. Press Reset button to turn off both safety and timed mode. Cannot be triggered while contained in inventory or any other kind of container. If Safety is active, remote detonator won't have any effect on the charge, but signal received from direct wire connection will still trigger it.
infotexts.entitydescription.aimaasist: A complex tactical visor system, developed to assist operators in firefights by calculating bullet trajectory and highlighting important targets. Greatly increases wearer's combat performance.
infotexts.entitydescription.guidedgrenade: Rather a torpedo than a grenade, seeking enemies by their heat trail in water. Takes half a second to arm, then travels to closer non-human target, exploding on proximity. Can be used inside hulls as an impact grenade.
infotexts.entitydescription.proximitymine_50_monst: Upon being fired sticks to any surface or even creature, arming after a small delay and working as a proximity mine, detonating itself if anything passes closely. Disarms itself after a minute of being attached. Triggers on any non-human hostile creatures.
infotexts.entitydescription.proximitymine_50: Upon being fired sticks to any surface or even creature, arming after a small delay and working as a proximity mine, detonating itself if anything passes closely. Disarms itself after a minute of being attached. Triggers on any bypassing creature.
infotexts.entitydescription.infiniterifle: A plasma carbine that seems to be powered by a mysterious energy crystal. A sign on its stock claims that it has been produced in the Hellgrat Arms factory, though you doubt that such places even exist on Europa.
infotexts.entitydescription.40mmgrenadeincendiary_: A powerful 40MM grenade, filled with volatile explosive compound. Creates a massive blast as well as inflames everything around upon detonation.
infotexts.entitydescription.40mmgrenadefixafoam_co: A non-lethal 40MM grenade, filled with "Fix-a Foam" compound. Creates a blast that repairs any hull damage nearby it.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_ammobox_disp: A special container for delivering ammunition. Constructed from fragile polymers and can be easily broken down.
infotexts.entitydescription.powersword: A prototype energy weapon, releasing a massive discharge upon hitting any biological target. After a successful discharge, goes on a short cooldown of 4 seconds.
infotexts.entitydescription.crossbowboltpoison: A bolt, acting similar to a chemical bolt, but instead of emitting corrosive gas this bolt creates a cloud of compound, that severely increases targets vulnerability to damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.concussion_round: A special 11.5x24 round with low powder charge and non-lethal explosive bullet. Developed to quickly pacify those, for whom shockers and stun batons are not enough of a measure.
infotexts.entitydescription.concussion_carbine: Non-lethal 11.5x24 revolver rifle with unremovable drum, that can be accessed by breaking the weapon open. Commonly used by Coalition's police as a riot weapon, disorienting target, yet inflicting light injuries.
infotexts.entitydescription.accuraccystim: A combat stimulator, sharpening your reflexes lowering your heartbeat, reducing even the most insignificant hand fluctuations, greatly improving accuracy of ranged attacks.
infotexts.entitydescription.crossbowboltshock: A bolt with EMP warhead, upon impact emits a stunning field, slowing down larger creatures and completely immobilizing smaller ones.
infotexts.entitydescription.crossbowboltchem: A special crossbow bolt, carrying a flask of acid, that breaks upon contact, releasing a cloud of deadly mist, that burns through armor and what's beneath.
infotexts.entitydescription.crossbowboltlight: A special ammunition for crossbow, providing a strong light source upon impact. Comes in handy in caves and wrecks, easily lighting up huge areas, unlike normal flares, cannot be used to bait out hostile creatures.
infotexts.entitydescription.crossbowboltexplosive: An arrow-like projectile for crossbow with explosive warhead in shape of a reversed cone. Ideal for blasting doors open and penetrating submarine hulls, but is ineffective against fleshier targets.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_crossbow: A launching device for harpoons and bolts. May not be an effective weapon, but has some neat utility options, to assist you in a fight or during exploration.
infotexts.entitydescription.pocketflamer: A lightweight steam cannon that can fit in almost any container, including your pockets. It might seem underwhelming, but don't let that toy-like look distract you - it is still a lethal weapon, that may save your life in a critical moment.
infotexts.entitydescription.nucleargun_alt: Prototype weapon that utilizes the power of magnetic fields to accelerate steel and fulgurium 8x45mm needles. Uses its own magazines, performs perfectly in water and in air.
infotexts.entitydescription.proximityminelauncher: A 50MM launching device for sticky proximity mines. Has a button to remotely detonate all armed mines in a wide radius. Useful for ambushes and defensive operations.
infotexts.entitydescription.pyrogenrifle: Technically, not even a rifle, but a magnetic rail that propels hot plasma forwards. Uses highly-volatile Pyrogen tanks, ionizing gas inside and launching it at high speed. Weapon tends to rapidly overheat while fired constantly, which may result in severe burns or even explosion of the weapon itself.
infotexts.entitydescription.pyrogentank: A volatile mixture used as ammunition for X-129 Pyrogen rifle. When used in such creates a short burst of overheated plasma that explodes with power, comparable to military grenades.
infotexts.entitydescription.flamer_co: An improvised launching tube for literal fireballs of liquid incendium. What could possibly go wrong?
infotexts.entitydescription.co_bulletpouch_large: Allows you to more conveniently store and access rounds and shells.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_magazinepouch_large: Allows you to more conveniently access magazines.
infotexts.entitydescription.sturmfaust: Disposable launching device for 90MM HE rockets. Effective against doors, heavy armor, barricades and submarine hulls. Beware of the backblast.
infotexts.entitydescription.l39AT: The Lahti L-39, nicknamed ''Elephant Gun,'' is a Finnish semi-automatic, gas-operated 20mm anti-tank rifle with a top-mounted magazine, massive muzzle brake, and a unique bolt-open cooling system for faster heat dissipation.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_bulletpouch: Allows you to more conveniently store and access rounds, shells, bolts and 40MM grenades.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_magazinepouch: Allows you to more conveniently store and access magazines.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_militaryfabricator: A heavier version of standard fabricator, designed to produce military equipment, weapons and ammunition. Consumes significantly more power. Can be detached with a crowbar. Aim and press E key while inside the submarine to install.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_ammobox: A bulky metal box, used specifically for containing ammunition.
infotexts.entitydescription.flaksuit: A sturdy overcoat, made of ballistic fiber and light metal plates, designed to protect the user against shrapnel, burns and explosions. Can be easily penetrated by most calibers or bitten through by hostile creatures.
infotexts.entitydescription.divingknife_thermal: Heavy knife, utilizing high temperatures to deal increased damage. Has to be powered up by a battery for full efficiency, fulgurium batteries give higher temperatures at the blade's edge.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_iceax: Heavy tool designed to cut through ice and stone, or, in another case, through a submarine's hull. May be used instead of a plasma cutter to collect resources and force doors open.
infotexts.entitydescription.co_mace: Heavy and boxy blunt metallic mace, hits slow but hard.
infotexts.entitydescription.divingknife_m: A lightweight knife, designed to fight against hostile Europan fauna. Handy tool of survival, that may save your life when everything else fails.
infotexts.entitydescription.grozacase: A kit of tools and weaponry parts and schemes for fabricators. Used for rechambering OTSE rifles from 5.45x39 to 9x39 and backwards.
infotexts.entitydescription.laser_magazine_co: A powerful capacitor designed for LCM-301 laser carbine. Can be used as a battery cell, it also discharges slightly slower due to the integrated BMS.
infotexts.entitydescription.lasergun_co: Unique weapon, utilizing the power of short and powerful bursts of focused light. Unlike its bigger colleague, this laser does not need any chemical mixture, but only a reliable power source, such as its own battery arrays. Earned its name for a peculiar firing sound.
infotexts.entitydescription.balaklava: A facemask, made of durable organic fiber. Mostly associated with illegals, but may come in handy if you prefer staying incognito or just got cold.
infotexts.entitydescription.grenadelauncher_m99: Destructive weapon, capable of shooting six 40MM grenades without reloading. Used with non-lethal ammunition as a police weapon against rioters, but can dish out devastating amounts of destruction and raw firepower, if loaded with military-purposed grenades.
infotexts.entitydescription.grenadelauncher-gp: Compact pump-action grenade launcher, capable of holding 3 40MM grenades. Was a basic piece of Rosguard equipment, found its purpose on Europa as a riot-control weapon with underwater shooting ability.
infotexts.entitydescription.grenadelauncher_m500: 40MM Grenade launcher, used by Earth's military. Found its purpose on Europa as a heavy weapon of choice against large monsters or heavily-armored humans.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mothersblessing: The Honkmother has noticed your love and has given you a warm embrace strong enough to withstand the pressures of Europa.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.dmind: Patient's vision is blurred. Their head hurts terribly and they are struggling with movement and navigation.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.crit: Theres a chance your weapon lands an especially painfull shot.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.co_burning: The burning you feel? It is shame..
infotexts.afflictiondescription.exocarry: Patient has an exoskeleton on him.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.marksmansuit: Patient has a marksman exoskelton on him.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.aasoverlay: You see an annoying red transparent display before your eyes.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.co_nearbydanger: You feel weak, yet inspired for deeds.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.co_weakness: Your pain threshhold is greatly lowered.
infotexts.tutorial.gunrange.description: This tutorial teaches you how to protect yourself against any who you see as a threat.
infotexts.tutorial.showcase.description: This isnt a tutorial, rather its a area to test every weapon in COR and to help find bugs.
infotexts.tutorial.gunrange.message.2: “You're in a prison cell, are you blind?”
infotexts.tutorial.gunrange.message.3: "Welcome to the club. Seems you're not one of those lunatics either."
infotexts.tutorial.gunrange.message.4: “Anyways, let's get you out of there! Go ahead and check your vent. I stashed something in there just in case I got put in there again,” he suggests, with a sense of urgency.
infotexts.tutorial.gunrange.doormessage.1: "Ah, crap! Looks like a silent alarm got triggered when you opened that door. Luckily, it seems they've left for a while,"
infotexts.tutorial.gunrange.doormessage.2: "Well.. where exactly we are.. I have no idea, but what I can tell you is that we're in some sort of research facility"
infotexts.tutorial.gunrange.doormessage.2_player: “"How fun.. I'm going to go look for an escape pod," you remark, with a hint of sarcasm.
infotexts.tutorial.gunrange.aimandfire: To aim your firearm, hold the [InputType.Aim] button, then press [InputType.Shoot] to fire.
infotexts.tutorial.gunrange.completed: "Well, we got out, but this is where we part ways. I do hope to see you again, in a better station this time," he says, extending his hand for a farewell handshake.\nAn automated system announces, "Congratulations. Your odds of survival have increased by a factor 15 percent."
